local local_class = newclass("CoopEscapeController")

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 상수 값들 모아두기
	self.labose_scale = 1.4
	self.break_sfx_name = '02_break_flag_02'
	self.break_duration = 4

	self.drone_shield_sfx_name = '02_conquest_shield_01'
	self.drone_prop_sfx_name = '01_propeller_03'
	self.bug_sfx_name = '01_bugs_loop_03'
	self.bug_hit_sfx_name = '01_hit_bugs_01'

	self.FirstImpact = 1.5 / 6.3
	self.SecondImpact = 3.7 / 6.3
	self.ImpactTime = 0.2
	self.DestroyFlagSfxHandleName = '02_destroy_flag_02'
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(self.load_resource_routine, self)
end

function local_class:load_resource_routine()
	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("pvp_entry")

	-- 라보스 연출 리소스 로드
	self.labose_fx_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_labose_bomb_leak_rewind')
	self.drone_fx_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_labose_bomb_bubble_shield')

	-- Subscribe Events
	self.flag_func = function(e)
		self:on_flag_stage_changed(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CoopLaboseBombStateChangedEvent), self.flag_func)

	self.start_flag_direction = false
	self.check_end_result = false
	self.finish_check = false
	self.start_check = false

	coroutine.yield(unity_object_pool.WaitUntilLoaded(pool))
end

function local_class:on_flag_stage_changed(e)
	-- 라보스 상태 전환에 따른 연출
	if e.State == CS.Oak.LaboseBombState.Interact then
		-- FIXME: 드론이 도착 한 후에 인터랙션 되게 윗단에서 처리가 되어야 한다.
		-- 인터랙터 정보도 추가로 받아야 함.
		if self.start_flag_direction == false then
			-- 종료 연출 시작
			self.start_flag_direction = true
			start_coroutine(self.flag_clear_sequence, self, e.FieldObject, e.Interactor)
		end
	elseif e.stage == CS.Oak.LaboseBombState.Cancel then
		-- 캔슬 안먹게 할 것. (인터랙트 시작 한 시점에서 클리어 처리. 이후는 모두 단순 연출)
	elseif e.State == CS.Oak.LaboseBombState.Finish then
		-- 완료 후 처리도 별도로 없음. 코루틴에서 모두 제어.
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:flag_clear_sequence(flag_object, interactor)
	-- 클리어 연출
	local drone = get_character('coop_champion_drone')
	local labose = get_character('coop_champion_labose')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		-- HACK: 디싱크 및 연출 꼬임 방지를 위해 무적
		character_util.set_immortal(user_party[i], true)
	end

	-- 드론이 라보스에 보호막을 씌움
	self.drone_fx = self.drone_fx_pool:Instantiate(labose.Position)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.drone_shield_sfx_name)

	-- 클리어 플래그 연출
	if interactor.Position.x < flag_object.Bounds.center.x then
		interactor.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	else
		interactor.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end

	stage_camera:Shake(CS.Oak.ShakeInfo('enemy_flag_zeroth', 0.03, 100, false))
	field:Darken('enemy_flag_zeroth', 0.25, 0.15)

	message_system:SendSync(interactor.FieldObjectController,
			CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterControllerInteractState.Create(interactor, flag_object)))

	local bgm_state = music_player.StageBgmState
	if music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Fanfare then
	 -- 팡파레의 경우 예외처리
		bgm_state = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field
	end

	-- 몰입감을 위해 BGM Fade Out
	music_player:ChangeStageMusicVolume(bgm_state, 0.2, 2.5)

	-- 오브젝트 파괴 sfx
	local sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	sfx_info.sfxName = self.break_sfx_name
	sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Gimmick
	sfx_info.playerPriority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriority.Object

	local break_sfx_holder = music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)

	-- 인터랙터 상태
	local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(interactor, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('eat', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true))
	state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Gathering
	message_system:SendSync(interactor.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state))

	interactor:SetEmotion(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('attack', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))

	-- 인터랙트 게이지
	local ui_dict = field_ui_manager:SetUI(flag_object, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	local timer_bar = ui_dict[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.break_duration)
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0)
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.break_duration, self.break_duration)
	timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	-- 업데이트 연출
	local firstImpactTime = self.FirstImpact * self.break_duration
	local secondImpactTime = self.SecondImpact * self.break_duration

	-- 줌인 스케일 수정
	local start = stage_camera:GetDefaultSize()
	local firstImpactScale = 3.8
	local firstImpactAfterScale = 3.5
	local secondImpactScale = 3.3
	local secondImpactAfterScale = 3.0

	-- 인터랙터에게 카메라 붙이기
	stage_camera:Move(interactor, firstImpactTime * 0.65, interactor, true)

	-- update via time progress
	local time_passed = 0

	while (time_passed < firstImpactTime) do
		local progress = time_passed / firstImpactTime
		local targetScale = start * (1-progress) + firstImpactScale * progress
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(targetScale, 0)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- first Impact
	stage_camera:CancelShake('enemy_flag_zeroth')
	stage_camera:Shake(CS.Oak.ShakeInfo('enemy_flag_first', 0.05, 100, false))
	stage_camera:Shake(CS.Oak.ShakeInfo(nil, 0.12, 0.1, false))

	field:Undarken('enemy_flag_zeroth', 0)
	field:Darken('enemy_flag_first', 0.5, self.ImpactTime)

	while (time_passed < firstImpactTime + self.ImpactTime) do
		local progress = (time_passed - firstImpactTime) / self.ImpactTime
		local targetScale = firstImpactScale * (1-progress) + firstImpactAfterScale * progress
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(targetScale, 0)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--
	while (time_passed <= secondImpactTime) do
		local progress = (time_passed - firstImpactTime - self.ImpactTime) / (secondImpactTime - firstImpactTime - self.ImpactTime)
		local targetScale = firstImpactAfterScale * (1-progress) + secondImpactScale * progress
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(targetScale, 0)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- second Impact
	stage_camera:CancelShake('enemy_flag_first')
	stage_camera:Shake(CS.Oak.ShakeInfo('enemy_flag_second', 0.07, 100, false))
	stage_camera:Shake(CS.Oak.ShakeInfo(nil, 0.12, 0.1, false))

	field:Undarken('enemy_flag_first', 0)
	field:Darken('enemy_flag_second', 0.75, self.ImpactTime)

	while (time_passed <= secondImpactTime + self.ImpactTime) do
		local progress = (time_passed - secondImpactTime) / (self.ImpactTime)
		local targetScale = secondImpactScale * (1-progress) + secondImpactAfterScale * progress
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(targetScale, 0)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	stage_camera:ResizeTo(secondImpactAfterScale, 0)

	-- final yield
	while (time_passed <= self.break_duration) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 최종 클리어 연출

	-- 연출 중에 네비게이션바 버튼들이 안눌리게 처리함
	local originNavigationBarState = true
	if not is_unity_null(CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance) then
		originNavigationBarState = CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = false
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(flag_object, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	party_util.stop()

	-- 새어 나오고 있던 이펙트 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.labose_fx) then
		self.labose_fx:Dispose()
	end
	self.labose_fx = nil

	if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.sfx_holder:FadeOut(2.0)
	end
	self.sfx_holder = nil

	interactor:SetAnimation(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest("eat", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))

	-- BGM Fade In
	music_player:ChangeStageMusicVolume(bgm_state, 1.0, 1.5)
	-- 점령 SFX Stop
	break_sfx_holder:FadeOut(0.05)
	-- 파괴 SFX Play
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.DestroyFlagSfxHandleName)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 암전 해제 뒤로 미룸
	field:Undarken('enemy_flag_second', 0.65)

	-- 이 시점에서 클리어 처리
	CS.Oak.CoopSystem.Instance.GameMode:DestroyClearFlag()

	stage_camera:Shake(CS.Oak.ShakeInfo(nil, 0.15, 0.35, false))
	stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(0.35)
	stage_camera:CancelShake('enemy_flag_second')

	interactor:RemoveEmotion()
	character_util.mario_jump_async(interactor, interactor.LockedDirection, 0.45, 0.4)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	interactor:SetAnimation(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('victory_extra', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))
	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	-- 카메라 복귀
	stage_camera:Move(user_party_leader, 0.35, user_party_leader, true)

	-- 만약 이 시점까지 결과 처리 안됐다면 대기
	if self.check_end_result ~= true then
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	interactor:RemoveAnimation()
	interactor.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted, 2.0)

	-- 연출 끝나고 NavigationBar 원래대로
	if not is_unity_null(CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance) then
		UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = originNavigationBarState
	end

	-- 연출 마무리
	-- 승리연출 시에만 여기로 오므로 조건 체크 안함
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(user_party[i], typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
			-- 좌 우 보도록 하고 빅토리 애니메이션 재생
			user_party[i].Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(user_party[i].Direction)
			user_party[i]:SetAnimation("victory_get", false)
		end
	end

	-- Clear Sound Changed
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("03_activity_clear_01")
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_crowd_clap_02")

	-- 1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 연출 완료 처리 (결과창 출력)
	self.cs_controller:FinishEndSequence()
end

function local_class:on_flood(e)
	if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
		local my_position = user_party.Leader.Position

		-- 현재 위치가 데미지 필드 영역 안에 있음
		if CS.Oak.CoopSystem.Instance.GameMode:IsInDamageField(my_position) then
			self.bug_sfx_pos = my_position
			self.sfx_holder:SetPosition(self.bug_sfx_pos)
		else
			local play_position = self.bug_sfx_pos
			local min_sqr_dist = vector_util.sqr_distance(my_position, play_position)

			local floors = e.Floors

			if floors.Count > 0 then
				for i = 0, floors.Count - 1 do
					local flood_position = CS.Utils.DecodeXz(floors[i])
					local this_sqr_dist = vector_util.sqr_distance(my_position, flood_position)

					if this_sqr_dist < min_sqr_dist then
						min_sqr_dist = this_sqr_dist
						play_position = flood_position
					end
				end

				self.bug_sfx_pos = play_position
				self.sfx_holder:SetPosition(self.bug_sfx_pos)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_sequence()
	if CS.Oak.CoopSystem.Instance.GameMode.IsDroneMode == true then
		start_coroutine(self.update_routine, self)
		return util.cs_generator(self.champ_start_sequence_routine, self)
	else
		return util.cs_generator(self.start_sequence_routine, self)
	end
end

function local_class:end_sequence()
	self.finish_check = true
	if CS.Oak.CoopSystem.Instance.GameMode.IsDroneMode == true and
			(CS.Oak.CoopClient.Instance.CoopGameEndState == CS.Oak.CoopResult.Victory) then
		return util.cs_generator(self.champ_end_sequence_routine, self)
	else
		return util.cs_generator(self.end_sequence_routine, self)
	end
end

function local_class:update_routine()
	local drone = get_character('coop_champion_drone')
	local me = user_party.Leader

	local drone_sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	drone_sfx_info.sfxName = self.drone_prop_sfx_name
	drone_sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Loop
	drone_sfx_info.playerPriority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriority.Npc
	drone_sfx_info.loop = true
	drone_sfx_info.playPosition = nil
	drone_sfx_info.parent = drone
	drone_sfx_info.fadeInTime = 1

	local labose_sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	labose_sfx_info.sfxName = self.bug_sfx_name
	labose_sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Loop
	labose_sfx_info.playerPriority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriority.Npc
	labose_sfx_info.loop = true
	labose_sfx_info.playPosition = nil
	labose_sfx_info.parent = me
	labose_sfx_info.fadeInTime = 1

	local drone_sfx_holder
	local last_drone_pos = drone.Position
	local drone_stop = true

	local labose_sfx_holder
	local labose_sfx_on = false

	while not self.finish_check do
		-- 드론 사운드
		local drone_pos = drone.Position

		if last_drone_pos == drone_pos then
			-- 정지된 상태
			if not drone_stop then
				drone_stop = true
				-- SFX FadeOut
				drone_sfx_holder:FadeOut(1)
				drone_sfx_holder = nil
			end
		else
			if drone_stop then
				drone_stop = false
				-- Play Drone SFX
				drone_sfx_holder = music_player:PlaySfx(drone_sfx_info)
			end
		end

		last_drone_pos = drone_pos

		-- 박테리아 사운드
		if self.start_check == true then
			if CS.Oak.CoopSystem.Instance.GameMode:IsInDamageField(me.Position) then
				if not labose_sfx_on then
					labose_sfx_on = true
					labose_sfx_holder = music_player:PlaySfx(labose_sfx_info)
				end
			else
				if labose_sfx_on then
					labose_sfx_on = false
					labose_sfx_holder:FadeOut(2)
					labose_sfx_holder = nil
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if drone_sfx_holder ~= nil then
		drone_sfx_holder:Stop()
	end

	if labose_sfx_holder ~= nil then
		labose_sfx_holder:Stop()
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, e.Info.target) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party.Leader) and CS.Oak.CoopSystem.Instance.GameMode:IsInDamageField(user_party.Leader.Position) then
		-- FIXME: 대미지 필드에서 대미지 받을 때 직접 전파되는 것 없어서 일단 타입 및 센더 비교 및 위치 확인 해서 처리
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.bug_hit_sfx_name)
	end
end

function local_class:champ_start_sequence_routine()
	-- 히트 사운드 처리 위해 구독
	self.on_damage_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_func)

	-- 라보스 임시 스케일링 및 초기 애니메이션 세팅
	local labose = get_character('coop_champion_labose')
	labose:SetScale(unity_class.vector3(self.labose_scale,self.labose_scale,self.labose_scale), 0)
	labose:SetAnimation('crack_3 ', true)

	self.labose_fx = self.labose_fx_pool:Instantiate(labose.Position)

	-- 탑 이펙트보다 더 위에 와야 함
	local drone = get_character('coop_champion_drone')
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(drone, 'UI', -1)

	-- 공통 처리
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(user_party[i], typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
			message_system:SendSync(user_party[i].FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield()

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(user_party[i], typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
			field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DuelPlayerName)

			if CS.Oak.CoopStageSpec.IsCoopUnifiedMatching(stage.StageId) and
					user_party[i].Owner ~= CS.Oak.Player.Local then

				local field_ui = field_ui_manager:GetUI(user_party[i])

				local has_value, field_ui_character_stats = field_ui:TryGetValue(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

				if has_value and lua_helper.type_compare(field_ui_character_stats, CS.Oak.FieldUICharacterStats) then
					field_ui_character_stats.Level.gameObject:SetActive(false)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ControllerBlockEvent.Create(true, CS.Oak.ControllerBlockReason.FieldTopUiPanel))

	-- 3 2 1
	local entryPool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("pvp_entry")
	local entryComponent = entryPool:Instantiate(field_ui_manager.FieldUICamera.transform.position):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UIPvPEntry))
	entryComponent.transform.parent = stage.UIRoot.transform
	entryComponent.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3(0, 100, 0)
	entryComponent.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	-- shake sfx
	music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true, fadeInTime = 1.5, fadeOutTime = 1.5, duration = 4})

	local entryState = CS.Oak.UIPvPEntry.State()
	entryState.startTime = CS.GameTime.ServerTime
	entryState.callback = function(i)
							message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopStageCountDownEvent.Create(i))

							if i == 2 then
								screenplay_operations.shake({ 0.1, 1.95 })
							end
						end
	coroutine.yield(entryComponent:Show(entryState))

	CS.Oak.RaidApiRequester.SendStartPhase(0)

	self.start_check = true
end

function local_class:start_sequence_routine()
	-- 이벤트 구독 (루프 사운드 위치 처리용)
	self.flood_func = function(e)
		self:on_flood(e)
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MiniMapFloorFillEvent), self.flood_func)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(user_party[i], typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
			message_system:SendSync(user_party[i].FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield()

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(user_party[i], typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
			field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DuelPlayerName)

			if CS.Oak.CoopStageSpec.IsCoopUnifiedMatching(stage.StageId) and
				user_party[i].Owner ~= CS.Oak.Player.Local then

				local field_ui = field_ui_manager:GetUI(user_party[i])

				local has_value, field_ui_character_stats = field_ui:TryGetValue(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

				if has_value and lua_helper.type_compare(field_ui_character_stats, CS.Oak.FieldUICharacterStats) then
					field_ui_character_stats.Level.gameObject:SetActive(false)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ControllerBlockEvent.Create(true, CS.Oak.ControllerBlockReason.FieldTopUiPanel))

	-- 3 2 1
	local entryPool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("pvp_entry")
	local entryComponent = entryPool:Instantiate(field_ui_manager.FieldUICamera.transform.position):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UIPvPEntry))
	entryComponent.transform.parent = stage.UIRoot.transform
	entryComponent.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3(0, 100, 0)
	entryComponent.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	-- shake sfx
	music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true, fadeInTime = 1.5, fadeOutTime = 1.5, duration = 4})

	coroutine.yield(entryComponent:Show(CS.GameTime.ServerTime, function(i)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopStageCountDownEvent.Create(i))

		if i == 2 then
			screenplay_operations.shake({ 0.1, 1.95 })
		elseif i == 0 then
			self.bug_sfx_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
			self.sfx_holder = music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '01_bugs_loop_01',
													 typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Loop, loop = true,
													 fadeInTime = 2, fadeOutTime = 2, playPosition = self.bug_sfx_pos})
		end
	end))

	CS.Oak.RaidApiRequester.SendStartPhase(0)
end

function local_class:end_sequence_routine()
	if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.sfx_holder:FadeOut(2.0)
		self.sfx_holder = nil
	end

	if (CS.Oak.CoopClient.Instance.CoopGameEndState == CS.Oak.CoopResult.Victory) then
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(user_party[i], typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
				-- 좌 우 보도록 하고 빅토리 애니메이션 재생
				user_party[i].Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(user_party[i].Direction)
				user_party[i]:SetAnimation("victory_get", false)
			end
		end

		-- Clear Sound Changed
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("03_activity_clear_01")
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_crowd_clap_02")

		-- 1.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end

	self.cs_controller:FinishEndSequence()
end

-- 챔피언 모드 종료 연출 시퀀스 - 실제로 이게 왔을 때 아직 플래그 연출 돌고 있을 것임.
function local_class:champ_end_sequence_routine()
	coroutine.yield()
	-- 연출은 하나로 통합
	self.check_end_result = true
	coroutine.yield()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- 구독 해제
	if self.flood_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MiniMapFloorFillEvent), self.flood_func)
		self.flood_func = nil
	end

	if self.flag_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CoopLaboseBombStateChangedEvent), self.flag_func)
		self.flag_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_damage_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_func)
		self.on_damage_func = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.labose_fx) then
		self.labose_fx:Dispose()
	end
	self.labose_fx = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.drone_fx) then
		self.drone_fx:Dispose()
	end
	self.drone_fx = nil

	self.labose_fx_pool = nil
	self.drone_fx_pool = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass("CoopExpeditionBossController")

function local_class:init(cs_controller, scene)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	if scene ~= nil then
		self.scene = scene()
	end

	self.resource_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 해당 컨트롤러에 필요한 데이터 셋 불러오기.
	self.expedition_boss_data = require('stageeventcontrollers/CoopExpeditionBossData.lua')
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource_routine, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	-- 현재 스테이지의 전용 연출이 있으면 추가
	local current_info = self.expedition_boss_data[stage.Spec.Id]
	if current_info and current_info.controller then
		self.expedition_add_on = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.Create('stageeventcontrollers/ExpeditionAddon/' .. current_info.controller)
		self.expedition_add_on:on_load_resource_routine(current_info.param_table)
	end

	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("pvp_entry")
	coroutine.yield(unity_object_pool.WaitUntilLoaded(pool))
end

function local_class:on_launch(start_point_name)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_launch_routine, self))
end

function local_class:on_launch_routine()
	-- 초반부터 캐릭터 돌아다닐수 있음.

	-- FadeIn 전 연출 준비
	if self.expedition_add_on then
		self.expedition_add_on:pre_launch_routine()
	end

	CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:FadeIn(0, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine)
	CS.Oak.CircularScreenTransition.Instance:FadeIn(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine)

	-- 카메라 페이드 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 보스 등장 연출 시작
	if self.expedition_add_on then
		self.expedition_add_on:on_launch_routine()
	end

	-- 보스 등장 연출 종료
	if self.expedition_add_on then
		self.expedition_add_on:post_launch_routine()
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ControllerBlockEvent.Create(true, CS.Oak.ControllerBlockReason.FieldTopUiPanel))
	CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionApiRequester.SendStartPhase(0)

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.expedition_add_on then
		self.expedition_add_on:dispose()
	end
	self.expedition_boss_data = nil

	self.scene = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller, scene)
		return local_class(cs_controller, scene);
	end
}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(user_party[i], typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
			message_system:SendSync(user_party[i].FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield()

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(user_party[i], typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then

				user_party[i].Owner ~= CS.Oak.Player.Local then

				local field_ui = field_ui_manager:GetUI(user_party[i])

				local has_value, field_ui_character_stats = field_ui:TryGetValue(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

				if has_value and lua_helper.type_compare(field_ui_character_stats, CS.Oak.FieldUICharacterStats) then

				end
			end
		end

	entryComponent.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3(0, 100, 0)
	entryComponent.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	-- music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true, fadeInTime = 1.5, fadeOutTime = 1.5, duration = 4 })

	local entryState = CS.Oak.UIPvPEntry.State()
	entryState.startTime = CS.GameTime.ServerTime
	entryState.callback = function(i)
							message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopStageCountDownEvent.Create(i))
						end
	coroutine.yield(entryComponent:Show(entryState))

	CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionApiRequester.SendStartPhase(0)
